registers.calm: Owner-facing. Precise, warm, unhurried. Specific over superlative. Used for website, proposals, standards, owner email, SMS, legal/financial.
registers.real-talk: Cara after seventeen years, telling it straight. Funny, candid, Reddit-literate. Used for social captions, the investor booklet, videos.

core: Plain English. Short sentences. First person plural - 'we', never 'the agency'.
Specific over superlative: a number, a timeframe, a named check.
Say it straight, with respect. Hard news delivered calmly, never softened into vagueness.
Australian spelling. No exclamation marks. Taglines always set straight, never italic.
Kind, always - including about tenants, trades and other agents.
never: Promise outcomes we can't control - rent levels, tenant behaviour, the market.
Hype words: premium, passionate, exceptional, stress-free, seamless, world-class, bespoke.
Mock a tenant or an owner. Name a competitor.
Urgency theatre, ALL CAPS sentences, emoji in owner-facing email or standards.
Italics on taglines. Exclamation marks anywhere.

lines.guarantee: If we don't deliver, you don't pay.
lines.campaign: Never chase your property manager again.
lines.segment-remote-investor: Property income, without the second job.
lines.testimonial: The last property manager you'll switch to.
